# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility to generate a safe HTML response by embedding user-provided content into a predefined template. The function escapes any special characters in the user content to prevent Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS) attacks and ensures that the resulting HTML is well‑formed. CWE-707 (Improper Neutralization of Structured Data) is mitigated by using html.escape, which neutralizes HTML special characters before the content reaches the browser. """ import html # Example template; in real use this would come from your application context html_template: str = """ Safe Response

User Content

{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generate an HTML response by safely embedding user-provided content. Parameters ---------- user_content : str The raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML. Returns ------- str The fully formed, escaped HTML response. """ # Ensure we have a string; if not, convert to empty string if user_content is None: safe_content = "" else: # Escape special HTML characters to avoid injection safe_content = html.escape(str(user_content), quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
